friction.what: Bash heredoc could not write the workflow file
friction.detail: cat > file <<'TSEOF' aborted with "here-document at line 175 delimited by end-of-file" and left a truncated 7267-byte file.
friction.resolution: Deleted the partial file and used the Write tool instead.

friction.detail: The HTML dashboard template was authored as an array of lines joined with .join('\n'). skills validate rejected it: "Dynamic expression not supported in node parameters ... only inline literal values (strings, numbers, booleans, null, arrays, plain objects) are supported."
friction.resolution: Folded the 42 lines into a single no-substitution template literal, which the parser accepts.

friction.what: A second heredoc-based fix script failed to match its own marker
friction.detail: node - <<'JSEOF' with an indexOf marker returned -1 despite the marker being present in the file (verified with grep | cat -A).
friction.resolution: Wrote the script to the scratchpad as fixhtml.js and ran it from there; it worked on the first try.

friction.what: Bundled ontology types collection parameters as any[]
friction.detail: Gmail 'filters' and Google Calendar 'options' are typed any[], so the sub-field names (filters.q, options.timeMin/timeMax/singleEvents/orderBy) could not be verified against the schema. They were written using the documented n8n shapes and accepted by both local validation and post-push verification.
friction.resolution: Accepted; flagged here because native MCP level 0 means no instance-exact check was possible.

friction.detail: push reported verbatim: "Validated against the bundled schema only (native MCP level 0 - discouraged, the instance may differ). Connect the instance MCP for instance-exact validation: n8nac native-mcp configure --level 1."
friction.resolution: Reported, not changed - the level must not be altered by the builder.

friction.what: No recipient address available for a daily send
friction.detail: The briefing needs a delivery step, but no recipient address exists in the workspace and inventing one was not acceptable.
friction.resolution: Used Gmail draft:create instead of message:send. The dashboard lands as an HTML draft in the user's own mailbox, so no address is invented and nothing is sent automatically.

friction.detail: workflow credential-required returned [] with exit 0 even though four nodes have empty credential slots, presumably because no credentials key is declared at all.
friction.resolution: Left as is; the empty slots are intentional and each affected node carries a note naming the credential type to pick.

notes: The instance was never listed, searched or inspected; only the id returned by push was used.
Workflow left inactive (active: false in the decorator, never activated).
No credential was created and no credential value was written anywhere.
Secrets in .env were never read; only the key names were listed, with values redacted.
